title: 25th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/25/2/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdhooh's proposal to remove a clause of Rule 257-1 of Parliament's Rules of Procedure is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the bill to amend the Income Tax Act (Law No. 25/2019), a government bill submitted by Mathiveri MP Hassan Zareer.
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Income Tax Act (Law No. 25/2019).

Continued debate (unfinished business) on Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed's resolution urging the government to immediately halt the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" selling permanent residency to foreigners and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Committee of the Whole House report on the bill to amend the Waste Management Act (Law No. 24/2022).
Finance Committee report on the bill to amend the National Payment System Act (Law No. 8/2021).
Environment and Climate Change Committee report on the bill to amend the Utility Regulatory Authority Act (Law No. 26/2020).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The income tax amendment bill was introduced and debated the same day, alongside committee reports on waste management, national payments and utility regulation bills.
